content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > The Red Sox will continue their second series of the season against the Astros with another night game in Houston.Boston right-hander Brayan Bello will make his first start of the 2026 campaign on Tuesday. The 26-year-old went 11-9 last year with a 3.35 ERA in 29 appearances. Hunter Brown will take the mound for the Astros and attempt to secure his first win of the season.
